WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




WHY THIS ROLE?

In this role, you will manage the team that owns the Cohere inference APIs and SDKs, as well as the Cohere Dashboard, where customers can access our models, manage teams, and audit billing. You will collaborate with internal partners to craft a delightful, intuitive, and unified experience across everything the Cohere APIs and Cohere Dashboard have to offer. As a hands-on leader, you will shift seamlessly between roles as mentor, strategist, and technologist to guide the team toward shared success.

Join our team of builders who are shaping the future of large language models!




AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER OF THE COHERE APIS AND DEVEX TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Manage, mentor, and grow a talented and enthusiastic team of backend and full-stack software engineers

 - Participate in model releases and develop new API capabilities

 - Work closely with Modelling and Model Serving teams

 - Collaborate with UX designers to ensure customers have an easy and delightful time managing teams, API keys, billing and configurations.

 - Oversee and contribute to open source projects
   
   


YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have experience managing engineering teams and a proven track record of delivering high-quality software

 - You have experience shipping products with a large number of stakeholders

 - You’re comfortable with the front and back end of the stack, and have previously worked with Go, Next.js, TypeScript, and React

 - You are passionate about recruiting and growing people and teams

 - You are passionate about building rapport with your team and you prioritize 1:1s

 - You have excellent communication skills and believe that documentation is a great way to get feedback and discuss technical implementations and designs

 - You have the ability to take complex needs and goals and develop easy to understand explanations for all audiences

 - You’re excited about AI and have the motivation to scale a company




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing AI organization in Vancouver. Asana is pioneering a new category of technology as the human-agent operating system, doubling down on our AI Suite to turn manual work into scalable, intelligent systems. We are hiring software engineers across several of our core AI teams, ranging from the platform foundations and runtime infrastructure powering autonomous agents, to the trust, evaluation, and observability systems that ensure safety and governance, to the high-impact product surfaces enabling users to build and run AI-orchestrated workflows. Because we are hiring for multiple teams, you will interview through a centralized interview process, and we will undergo a team matching process at the end.
 This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.
 What you’ll achieve 
 Own the end-to-end implementation of small-to-medium features and services that power intelligent collaboration and agentic automation across Asana.
 Write clean, modular, and well-tested code across our stack while evaluating trade-offs between latency, cost, and reliability when integrating modern foundation models, prompt pipelines, and workflow orchestration logic.
 Proactively maintain and improve Areas of Responsibility (AoRs), monitor production pipelines, participate in team on-call rotations, and diagnose complex bugs across asynchronous or distributed systems.
 Break down feature specifications into clear engineering milestones, provide accurate technical estimates, and reliably execute to advance the adoption of the AI Suite.
 Elevate code quality, advocate for test coverage and technical debt remediation, and conduct thoughtful and rigorous code reviews for your peers.
 About you 
 Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience shipping production code in modern distributed architectures, web services, or data-intensive systems.
 Strong command of software design fundamentals, testing practices, and data structures, paired with experience or curiosity in working with LLMs, prompt pipelines, vector databases, or agentic frameworks.
 Demonstrated ability to take a technical specification, evaluate trade-offs, seek feedback on risky or complex changes early, and ship to production with minimal oversight.
 High bar for code health, writing well-structured, maintainable, and self-documenting code with comprehensive test plans and logical PR breakdowns.
 Experience collaborating closely with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, and fellow engineers while communicating progress clearly and surfacing blockers early.
 At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.
 In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

 Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
 Career coaching & support

 Long-term savings or retirement plans
 In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

 Role Overview 
 We are seeking an experienced and forward-thinking Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Leader to provide strategic second-line oversight and shape our risk governance posture. In this critical role, you will act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, independently challenging first-line business operations while integrating risk considerations into new products, initiatives, and third-party partnerships. Combining traditional ERM rigor with modern analytical agility, you will champion a proactive risk-aware culture across our complex, regulated environment.
 Job Location: Hybrid (2–3 days in office) - based in Toronto, ON.
 Key Accountabilities 
 Second-Line Oversight & Strategic Advisory: Provide robust, independent oversight and effective challenge to first-line business units across operational, strategic, financial, and regulatory risk dimensions; advise leaders on proactively embedding risk management into new initiatives and product launches.
 ERM Policy & Risk Appetite Governance: Lead the periodic review and continuous enhancement of enterprise risk appetite statements, frameworks, and ERM policies to align with evolving organizational strategy and regulatory standards.
 Risk Assessments & Scenario Analysis: Design, facilitate, and execute comprehensive periodic and ad-hoc risk assessments across business units and corporate functions; actively contribute to enterprise-wide scenario analysis and stress testing to evaluate inherent risks, control effectiveness, and operational resilience.
 Vendor & Emerging Threat Surveillance: Oversee critical third-party vendor risks and conduct proactive horizon scanning for macroeconomic, industry, and geopolitical developments to provide forward-looking strategic impact analyses.
 KRI Monitoring & Incident Management: Establish, track, and analyze Key Risk Indicators (KRIs); oversee the incident management lifecycle by conducting thorough root-cause analyses on risk events and near-misses to drive sustainable remediation.
 Executive & Board Reporting: Translate complex risk metrics, trends, and assessment outcomes into clear, executive-ready dashboards and presentations for senior leadership and Board committees.
 Risk Culture & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with specialized risk functions and business leaders to foster a cohesive, risk-conscious culture through targeted training and transparent stakeholder engagement.
 Audit & Regulatory Liaison: Act as the primary ERM liaison for Internal Audit and regulatory bodies; manage review processes, track remediation commitments, ensure complete closure of findings, and monitor ongoing regulatory changes.
 Must Have(s) 
 Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive risk management experience within capital markets, financial services, or similarly complex, regulated corporate environments.
 Risk Governance Acumen: Broad-based expertise across enterprise risk domains (including Operational, Financial, and Strategic risk) and deep familiarity with standard risk governance frameworks.
 Executive Communication & Influence: Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills, with demonstrated success articulating nuanced risk concepts, challenging senior stakeholders constructively, and cultivating cross-functional partnerships.
 Technical Agility: Solid critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, coupled with an active interest in leveraging modern data analytics and Generative AI (GenAI) tools to streamline workflows and modernize risk processes.
 GRC Systems Experience: Practical experience implementing, administering, or utilizing enterprise GRC platforms (e.g., MetricStream, Archer, ServiceNow, Workiva, or equivalent).
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
 Nice to Have(s) 
 Professional risk or finance designations (e.g., FRM, PRM, CFA, CPA).
 Successful completion of the Canadian Securities Course (CSC).
 Proficiency with Google Workspace productivity and collaboration tools.

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision and strategy for the Financial Risk platform, balancing fraud prevention with client experience - every intervention has a cost, and you'll need to make sharp tradeoffs between friction and protection.

 - Drive the roadmap for the Decision Platform, our real-time rules engine that evaluates fraud risk across withdrawals, deposits, e-transfers, crypto transactions, and cheque deposits.

 - Build and improve fraud investigation tooling and automations - including case management workflows, alert deduplication, and enrichment pipelines - that help our fraud operations team investigate and resolve cases faster.

 - Define and evolve the restriction and mitigation framework that enables the right response to fraud signals: suspensions, withdrawal blocks, spend switch blocks, and account-level restrictions.

 - Operate as a platform PM, designing extensible APIs, decision schemas, and integration patterns that payment and money movement teams can reliably plug into as new products and payment rails launch.

 - Partner deeply with Fraud and Data Science teams on fraud model integration, fraud rule development, and the feedback loops that improve detection accuracy over time.

 - Own key risk metrics - fraud loss rates, false positive rates, investigation cycle times, decision latency - and use data to drive prioritization.

 - Break down complex, behind-the-scenes infrastructure projects into discrete phases that deliver value incrementally - this is platform work where the "client" is often another engineering team.
   
   


SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 8+ years of product management experience with significant depth in fraud, risk, or trust & safety - you've built fraud prevention systems, investigation tooling, or risk decisioning platforms and understand the cat-and-mouse dynamics of financial fraud.

 - Experience operating as a platform PM: you've built systems that other teams consume, and you know how to balance internal developer experience with business outcomes. You think in APIs, schemas, and extensibility.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep on streaming architectures, workflow orchestration, and ML model integration. You don't need to write code, but you need to reason about system design tradeoffs with engineering.

 - Comfort with breadth: this role spans real-time decisioning, investigation tooling, restrictions infrastructure, and regulatory reporting. You thrive when context-switching across a wide problem space, not when going narrow.

 - Data-driven decision making: you use quantitative analysis to identify fraud patterns, measure intervention effectiveness, and prioritize investments.

 - Experience working with fraud operations teams: you understand investigation workflows, alert triage, case management, and the tooling that makes analysts productive. You've closed the loop between detection and investigation.

 - A shipping mentality: we don't believe in spending forever analyzing and debating. The best way to validate a fraud rule is to ship it, monitor it, and iterate.

 - Strong communication skills: you can translate complex risk and platform concepts for engineering, operations, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

 - Ability to work independently: biasing towards action to drive projects forward across a broad surface area.

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Customer Experience at Brex 
 The Customer Experience (CX) team provides our customers with constant, live support as they build and grow their businesses. Our team is a passionate group that understands how to give customers a seamless support experience. In communication with our customers daily, we have the opportunity to provide insights and feedback, as well as identify process improvements to our partner teams—sales, products, operations, and engineering. We prioritize customer retention, which we accomplish by keeping high standards for how we serve our customers and making sure they leave every conversation satisfied and inspired.
 What you’ll do 
 Brex features a full suite of APIs to empower our customers and partners to never-before seen things in the finance world. As a Developer Support Specialist, you are the front-line point of contact supporting developers to be successful when using Brex’s API. This role is a hybrid position consisting of relations with external developers, Brex customers and working closely with Brex’s internal engineering, product, and design teams. Day-to-day, you work directly with external developers to advise on best practices, improve self-serve content, and investigate technical issues. You will also be partnering with internal engineering and design teams, triaging complex ticket escalations from Support, and closing the feedback loop between teams.
 This is a fantastic opportunity for someone early in their engineering career to work closely with developers.
 Responsibilities 
 Provide direct technical support to developers using Brex’s APIs, delivering the highest level of developer satisfaction
 Work closely with engineering, product, and design teams to ensure feedback from developers is captured and, where appropriate, used to build, drive and improve our tools and processes
 Attend or own calls with customer escalations as needed and own customer email queues
 Develop self-service options by creating and maintaining training material, customer resources and guides
 Directly field technical escalations from the Support team and follow engineering tickets through to resolution
 Recognized as a trusted ERP expert by owning escalations for Brex’s Integrations (NetSuite, QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct, Expensify, Concur, CoupaPay, Conferma, Workday ERP, Oracle Fusion, etc) working directly with customers, CSMs, or CX to solve their issue 
 What We Value 
 Bachelor's degree in related field or equivalent work experience
 Excellent problem solving, troubleshooting and debugging skills
 Good customer-centric attitude
 Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to communicate complex technical issues via email and in person
 Ability to hold yourself and the team to high standards
 Experience in a customer facing role in the past (this does not need to be a technical customer-facing role)
 Experience working with accounting integrations such as Netsuite, QBO, and Xero
 Bonus Points 
 Understanding financial systems and services
 Familiarity with programming languages 
 Experience working with SQL or NoSQL databases 
 Experience working with REST or GraphQL API calls
 Familiarity with software engineering development cycles 
 Experience using tools such as Looker, Datadog, Salesforce, Jira, Retool, and low-code/no-code tools
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role in Vancouver is $69,377 to $86,722 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.

Arondite is a defence technology company building the foundational software and AI to power the autonomous age. Our aim is to revolutionise the way organisations collaborate with robots, sensors and autonomous systems and use the data they generate. We are driven by our determination to help defend our collective democratic values and by our strong belief that an elite group of engineers can make a big difference. We are ambitious, well-funded and building for the long-term.
 You will join Arondite at a pivotal moment in the company’s journey. Our company is being built by exceptional engineers - people who find high-impact and technically challenging work engaging and exciting, and who consistently deliver outsized impact. You will collaborate with other brilliant minds to solve some of the world’s hardest and most important problems.
 You will have ownership and autonomy from Day One. There is no corporate ladder at Arondite. From your first day, you will directly influence the design, functionality, and direction of Arondite’s product offering. We hire the best people and give them extremely high levels of autonomy; the sky is the limit for an individual with the right ambition.
 If you are motivated by our mission and if you want to be part of a growing team of outstanding people, then we want to hear from you.
 About the role
 We are expanding into Canada as part of our next phase of growth. Ottawa is the proposed base for this effort because of its proximity to the Department of National Defence (DND), DRDC, federal government stakeholders and the wider public-sector ecosystem. Our initial objective is to establish a small, locally embedded team that can build trusted relationships and create an early go-to-market motion for Cobalt before growing into a broader Canadian office.
 Our Strategy & Partnerships team creates the relationships that bring our technology from concept to deployment. In Ottawa, you will lead that effort on the ground. You will identify high-value problems for us to solve, build relationships with defence and public-sector stakeholders, develop partnerships with Canadian organisations, and help establish Arondite as a credible and trusted participant in the Canadian defence and innovation ecosystem.
 This is a strategic and hands-on role. You will help define Arondite’s Canadian market approach while also executing the day-to-day work needed to build pipeline, qualify opportunities and move conversations forward. You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity, working independently and representing the company with senior stakeholders across government, industry and partner networks.
 Canada is a relationship-led market, and we see local presence as essential. This role is therefore intended to be Ottawa-based, with a strong focus on in-person engagement with DND, DRDC, IDEaS, relevant federal agencies and Canadian prime contractors.
 You will work closely with product and engineering teams in order to translate customer needs into product insight. The problems we are solving are technically ambitious, so you do not need to build the product yourself, but you do need to understand complex technical ideas, communicate them clearly and contribute meaningfully to discussions about roadmap, product positioning and deployment priorities.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Lead Arondite’s early business development and strategic engagement activity in Canada
 Build and maintain relationships with stakeholders across DND, DRDC, IDEaS, federal innovation programs and adjacent public-sector organisations
 Develop relationships with Canadian primes, technology partners and other organisations that can accelerate market access
 Identify, qualify and progress commercial opportunities relevant to Cobalt and Arondite’s wider offering
 Run structured customer discovery to test demand, refine positioning and surface priority use cases
 Work with internal teams to translate market signals into product insight, roadmap input and go-to-market recommendations
 Support partnership structuring, pricing discussions, proposal development and commercial negotiations
 Represent Arondite credibly in meetings, events and external conversations with senior decision-makers, and indeed as a spokesperson for media and governmental affairs
 Help shape Arondite’s long-term Canadian presence, including hiring insights, ecosystem mapping and local growth priorities
 You should have:
 Experience winning enterprise software, defence technology or complex public-sector deals in the Canadian defence or national security environment as a quota-carrying individual contributor or player-coach
 A strong understanding of how Canadian defence procurement, innovation funding and stakeholder engagement work in practice
 Experience building and managing senior relationships across government, defence, industry or technology organisations
 A track record of structuring and advancing partnerships in defence, public sector or other highly regulated environments
 Strong commercial judgement, including business case development, pricing awareness, communication and presentation skills
 The ability to work effectively in a fast-moving, high-growth company alongside engineers and technical teams
 The confidence to engage with technical subject matter and explain complex products to a wide range of audiences
 The ability to operate with high ownership and autonomy from day one
 You will be a key part of our early team in Canada, with significant opportunity to take on leadership responsibilities should you wish. Depending on your experience you may find yourself taking on a leadership role straight away.
 We know the ideal candidate may not match every line item exactly. If this role is close to your experience and you are motivated by the mission, we would still like to hear from you. 
 Nice to have:
 Understanding of the unique considerations involved in deploying AI solutions in defence contexts
 Experience selling AI or machine learning solutions in regulated environments
 Familiarity with responsible AI, defence AI ethics or assurance frameworks
 Knowledge of Canadian content considerations, industrial participation expectations or related contracting requirements
 Awareness of export controls, security requirements and information-handling constraints relevant to defence work
 We aim to provide competitive compensation, equity participation subject to local arrangements, and the tools and support needed to do your job well. Local benefits, employment structure and related arrangements for Canada will be aligned to the final operating model.
 Right to Work
 We require that all candidates have an existing Right to Work in Canada at the time of application.
 Security clearance
 We believe in working closely with defence customers. As a result, this role is likely to require you to hold a clearance or be willing to undergo Canadian security screening. This normally requires having continuous residency in Canada for at least 5 years for Reliability Status, and 10 years for Secret.
 Office vs hybrid working
 We are focused on building a positive, collaborative engineering-driven culture. We therefore believe in making the office a friendly, comfortable and fun place to be, and we try to work from the office where possible. Of course, there are times when it makes sense for you to work from home and that is OK. You may also need to travel to visit customers, depending on your role. But in general you should only apply to join Arondite if you are excited to come into the office and work in person by default.
 For this role, Ottawa is the intended base given the importance of being close to Canadian defence and federal stakeholders, while also being available for regular travel to customer sites as needed.
 You will be one of our early team in Canada and we are still finalising our benefits package. However, as a guide, we currently intend to progressively offer the benefits below:
 Generous equity scheme in Arondite so you have a stake in the company’s growth
 Generous employer pension contribution
 Private health and dental insurance
 Any resources, equipment and training that you need to do your job in a world-class way

 We are entering a new phase of modernization and growth, with a focus on stronger infrastructure, better automation, practical AI adoption, improved reliability, stronger security practices, and scalable systems that help our games and teams perform at a higher level.

 Big Viking Games is hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer, Agentic Automation & Live Games to modernize the infrastructure behind our live-service games and help reinvent how those systems are operated.
 This is a hands-on senior infrastructure role for someone fluent in modern cloud operations: AWS, containers, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, observability, production reliability, incident response, security, and automation.
 But this is not a traditional DevOps role.
 We are looking for someone who can build automation that does real work, not just scripts that run or dashboards that summarize. The right person has started using agentic coding tools, tool-calling systems, API integrations, workflow automation, or MCP-style tooling to safely diagnose, provision, remediate, monitor, or maintain infrastructure.

Uptime, data integrity, least-privilege access, rollback paths, auditability, and production safety matter.

 What You’ll Do
 Build Agentic Automation for Infrastructure Work
 Design, build, and operate agentic tooling that performs real DevOps work, including diagnosis, remediation, provisioning, routine maintenance, and operational follow-up.
 Build and maintain the integration layer that lets tooling act safely on our systems, including API integrations, MCP-style servers, webhook-driven orchestration, serverless functions, and permission-controlled automation.
 Convert manual runbooks, SOPs, recurring maintenance tasks, and repetitive operational chores into automation that can run unattended where appropriate.
 Establish guardrails that make automated action against production defensible, including least-privilege scopes, dry-run modes, approval paths, logging, audit trails, rollback plans, and clear escalation rules.
 Use agentic coding tools to accelerate infrastructure work, including IaC authoring, migration scripts, incident analysis, log analysis, documentation, and operational troubleshooting.
 Help improve how the wider engineering team uses automation and AI-assisted tooling safely and effectively.
 Own and Modernize Live Production Infrastructure
 Monitor, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure across AWS, Netlify, Vercel, and related platforms supporting our live games, data systems, internal tools, and operational workflows.
 Drive infrastructure modernization while maintaining uptime for live games with active player communities.
 Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK, Pulumi, or similar tools.
 Improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, deployment reliability, and environment management so teams can ship safely and frequently.
 Operate containerized workloads and GitOps-based deployment patterns.
 Improve local development, build, test, deploy, and production support workflows.
 Help manage cloud usage, resource tagging, environment efficiency, and infrastructure cost discipline.
 Reliability, Observability, and Security
 Rebuild and improve observability across the stack, including logging, metrics, alerting, dashboards, and operational visibility.
 Pay particular attention to early detection of silent failures, pipeline failures, data freshness issues, and degraded production behavior.
 Maintain and monitor data pipelines between game source databases, Snowflake, and downstream analytics and reporting systems.
 Own secrets and credential lifecycle management across platforms, including API key rotation, access controls, environment variable governance, and least-privilege practices.
 Support incident response, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and post-incident improvements.
 Automate the parts of incident response and remediation that repeat.
 Create documentation, runbooks, and SOPs that are executable wherever possible, not just descriptive.
 Improve backup, restore, disaster recovery, access review, and production-readiness practices.
 What You Bring
 Experience
 7+ years of experience in DevOps, infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, or a similar role.
 Strong hands-on experience designing, maintaining, and improving production infrastructure.
 Experience supporting live production systems where uptime, reliability, data integrity, and performance matter.

 Experience with CI/CD tooling, version control, deployment automation, and modern release workflows.
 Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, cloud security, monitoring, logging, and operational troubleshooting.
 Experience establishing observability, including choosing tooling, defining alerts, tuning alert noise, and creating useful dashboards.

 Security-aware mindset with practical experience in secrets management, credential rotation, access control, vulnerability reduction, and least-privilege practices.
 How You Work
 Self-starting. You identify the work rather than waiting for it to be assigned, and you can explain why one problem matters more than another.
 Proactive about toil. You notice repetitive work and treat it as a defect to be engineered away, not a cost of doing business.
 Inventive but pragmatic. You reach for novel approaches where they genuinely help and recognize when a simple script is the better answer.

Who We Are 
 SWTCH is pioneering EV charging solutions for multifamily and commercial properties across North America. Since 2016, our team of entrepreneurs, energy professionals, and technologists has been focused on unlocking the social, economic, and environmental benefits of widespread EV adoption. Today, our solutions are deployed in tens of thousands of locations —many of which are low-to-moderate income housing—helping to make clean mobility accessible for all.
 With an expanding footprint across Canada and the U.S., we’re scaling quickly and looking for mission-driven talent to help accelerate our growth.
 Job Opportunity 
 We are looking for a dedicated, hard-working Product Manager who will be a key part of the SWTCH development team. You will be overseeing the entire product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and beyond. As a tremendous resource on the team, you will bring new and thoughtful self-care solutions to our customers – this will include managing the product backlog, prioritizing the various product, market, customer, and organization needs to successfully deliver a large and complex product enhancement, and drive the go-to-market function for the product organization. 
 Responsibilities: 
 1. Develop Product Requirements: You don’t just write tickets; you craft the blueprint for our success. You will take ownership of the "what" and the "why," ensuring every requirement is rooted in user needs and technical feasibility.
 The Details + The Care: Create precise requirements (PRDs) that account for every edge case with a genuine focus on making the charging experience seamless and reliable for our users.
 The AI Edge: Proactively use AI tools to analyze user feedback, simulate complex workflows, and identify logic gaps before development begins to ensure our solutions are future-proof.
 2. Ensure High-Quality Delivery: At SWTCH, "shipped" is not the same as "done." You are the guardian of quality, working side-by-side with developers to ensure the final product matches the vision.
 Attention to Detail: Lead meticulous testing and partner with engineering to resolve technical hurdles, ensuring every feature is polished, bug-free, and reliable before it reaches the field.
 Continuous Learning: Obsessively monitor post-launch performance and gather feedback to ensure we are delivering the right outcomes, treating every release as an opportunity to iterate and improve.
 3. Communicate Knowledge Internally & Externally: You are the primary storyteller for your product area. You translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for all stakeholders.
 Internal Evangelism: Keep the entire organization aligned and inspired by clearly communicating the product roadmap, progress, and strategic wins across departments.
 External Thought Leadership: Create simple, high-impact documentation and presentations that explain the value of our technology—from smart load management to bidirectional charging—to our customers and the industry.
 Job Qualification: 
 Proven PM Track Record: 3–5+ years of experience in Product Management, ideally within SaaS, IoT, or GreenTech.
 AI-Forward Mindset: Proficiency in using AI (LLMs, prompt engineering) to accelerate your workflow and a vision for how AI can improve the user experience for EV drivers.
 Obsession with Detail: A natural "quality-first" instinct. You are the person who catches the missing edge cases and inconsistencies that others miss.
 A Culture of Care: High emotional intelligence. You care about the "human" impact of your work—from the developer’s workflow to the driver’s experience at the charger.
 Continuous Learner: An active, documented passion for staying ahead of industry trends and a hunger to constantly level up your skills in a fast-moving market.
 Bonus Points (Nice to Have) 
 Technical Fluency: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field that allows you to engage deeply with developers on architectural trade-offs and infrastructure constraints.
 Business Impact - As a core member of the team, you have the opportunity to take a supporting role and make a significant impact on the culture and values of the company.
 Environmental Impact - We are a clean energy company with a mission to reduce carbon emissions globally to ensure a clean and sustainable future.
 Diversity - People develop their talents and skills in different ways. We value different paths and experiences. If you think you meet the qualifications we are seeking, take a chance and express your interest here.

All qualifications will be done face-to-face, whether that is in person or over Google Meet.
